newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac, Jospin to meet again on cabinet at 1700 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Chirac, Jospin to meet again on cabinet at 1700 GMT.

text.p: Socialist French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin and conservative President Jacques Chirac will hold a second meeting at 7 p.m. (1700 GMT) on Wednesday on the formation of a broad-left cabinet, the president's office said.

Jospin said the first meeting in mid-afternoon went very well. Socialist sources said he had presented his list for "sensitive ministries" first for the president's approval and would submit a complete list later.
